title: Illumina DNA Prep - Post Tagmentation Clean Up
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Input your protocol parameters in the OT App interface as prompted.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol file and unzip it if necessary.

steps.title: Upload custom labware
steps.instruction: In the OT App, go to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and select your custom labware files with a .json extension, if needed.

steps.title: Upload protocol file
steps.instruction: Upload your protocol file (with a .py extension) to the OT App via the Protocol tab.

steps.title: Arrange deck layout
steps.instruction: Set up the robot deck according to the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Calibrate all labware, tip racks, and the pipette using the OT App calibration workflow; refer to support articles for tips.

steps.title: Start the run
steps.instruction: Press the Run button in the OT App to begin the protocol.
